findings.summary: Director at OPTIM CONSULT LIMITED (UK, Companies House No. 04108618, dissolved). Appointed Feb 21 2019, resigned Mar 14 2019 (short tenure). Re-appointed Aug 31, 2020. Company is dissolved. Confirms French nationality and Grilly, France (01220) address.

TEP (Trust and Estate Practitioner) qualified. Former Chair of STEP Switzerland and Liechtenstein Federation. Former Chair of XLNC Wealth Management and Estate Planning Focus Group. Recognized: Women in Wealth Management Switzerland 2022; Most Influential European Businesswomen 2025. TrustConsult Geneva team won Best Wealth Planning Advisors 2023 and Best Corporate Service Provider 2024 under her leadership.

Director and Founding Partner & CEO of META OCTAV GROUP (HK) LIMITED (formerly International Fiduciaries Limited), effective August 2025. Co-director with Kenneth Raymond Deayton. Entity holds TCSP licence TC007309 at 6/F Wyndham Place, 40-44 Wyndham Street, Central HK — same address as Deayton's HKCS Group.

Career trajectory: UK/France (pre-2018) → Generations Cornerstone Geneva (Jan 2018, trust planning) → TrustConsult Group Switzerland (CEO Switzerland/Head of Private Clients, ~2019; CEO of TrustConsult group, Aug 2021) → Meta Octav Group SA founding partner (Switzerland, Jul 2025) → META OCTAV GROUP (HK) LIMITED Founding Partner & CEO (Aug 2025+). French national, DOB October 1971, residence: Grilly, France (01220, near Geneva).

NEGATIVE RESULTS: No hits in OpenSanctions, LMSBAND, DOJ corpus, LittleSis, SAM.gov, GLEIF, SEC EDGAR full-text, or CourtListener. No FEC donations. No FARA registration. No US corporate registrations. Investigation footprint limited to HK Companies Registry, UK Companies House, and professional media profiles.

Vuillier's departure from TrustConsult Group: still listed as panelist/CEO of TrustConsult (Suisse) SA at TrustConsult Annual Conference Monaco, March 20 2025. Meta Octav Group SA (Geneva) incorporated July 2, 2025 — her departure occurred between March and July 2025. No public announcement of departure found.

connections.description: Vuillier succeeded Butler as head of IFL/META OCTAV GROUP (HK) LIMITED approx August 2025. Butler was MD/founder 2011-~2025; Vuillier appointed Founding Partner & CEO at rebranding.
